verdict.rationale: Fenwick's Startup Resource Center offers founder-facing formation materials. These include an 'Incorporation Stage Issues' overview and a 'Top 10 Legal Issues for Startups' guide that explicitly advises putting appropriate equity vesting in place. The evidence only names these resources at headline level and never shows their contents covering the specific mechanics. Missing for 10: any mention of 83(b) elections, co-founder equity split guidance, detail on vesting schedules (cliffs, acceleration), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the resources' content.
